motions.name: 流行爵士 · 八拍 01
motions.reviewNotes: Original author label: Street / Jazz. Selected as New Jazz / pop-jazz personal practice adaptation, not a dance-teacher certification. Reviewed all 16 full-phrase boards and 40 selected transition boards on the supplied female/male rigs; source ~115 BPM, 52-joint quaternion tracks. Both rigs passed movement, rotation, switch-continuity and full-mesh floor checks (+8 mm clearance). Only the listed connections are approved. Motion data and visual evidence remain local and restricted.
